personality_one_liner: A clean, data-forward, sensory-rich iOS experience that balances beautiful food imagery with highly legible, confident nutritional metrics.

spacing.rule: Generous iOS native padding; cards never flush to edges. Large safe-area padding at bottom for sticky CTAs.

do's: Use glass on bottom tab bar to let scrolling content peek through.
Use glass on sticky headers and floating bottom CTAs.
Apply translucent tinted base under glass to ensure readability.
dont's: Never apply glass to dense macro cards or form fields.
Do not use glass without a sufficient tinted backdrop.

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: A visually engaging personalization questionnaire to gather age, weight, and fitness goals.

states.loading: Subtle skeleton loaders inside the input fields.
states.error: Inline red error text below the invalid field with a shake animation.

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse). Persistent progress bar at the top. Large display text for the question. Touch-friendly selection cards for choices (gender, goal), and large sticky brandPrimary CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Home (Today)
screens.purpose: The daily command center displaying calorie/macro rings and the logged meals journal.

states.loading: Central iOS spinner with skeleton macro rings.
states.empty: Use the empty plate illustration + 'No meals logged today' text + 'Scan a Meal' primary button.
states.error: Error toast at top + 'Tap to retry loading your journal'.

screens.layout: Top section: A large hero card featuring circular progress rings for calories and linear bars for macros. Typography uses tabular numerals (tnum) for all stats to avoid jitter. Below: 'Today's Meals' grouped into breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks. Each logged meal is a horizontal card (surfaceSecondary) with a leading thumbnail image of the scanned food, title, and calorie count.

screens.name: Camera / Scan
screens.purpose: A frictionless, one-tap AI food scanning interface.

states.loading: Animated scanning reticle over the camera view with a colorful gradient processing bar.
states.empty: Camera view active, waiting for subject.
states.error: Modal over camera: 'Could not detect food. Please try again or log manually.'

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. Large, pill-shaped 'Capture' button sticky at the bottom center. After capture, a bottom sheet glides up showing the AI's editable result card with a confidence score, detected food title, serving size editor, and immediate macros breakdown.

screens.name: Meal Plan
screens.purpose: Personalized AI-generated meal plan based on user's profile and progress.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + 'Let our AI generate your first meal plan'.
states.error: Standard readable message with Retry CTA.

screens.layout: Segmented control at the top (Days of the week). Vertical list of meal cards. Each card uses a full-width background photo of the meal with a top-to-bottom dark scrim, overlaying the meal title, prep time, and macros in white (onSurfaceInverse) at the bottom.

screens.name: Progress / History
screens.purpose: Weekly and monthly macro and calorie trends.

states.empty: Empty state illustration showing 'Log a full week to unlock trends'.
states.error: Retry button centered on the screen.

screens.layout: Data-heavy interface with elevated chart cards (surfaceSecondary). Large typography for weekly averages. Tabular numerals. Tonal background strips alternating to separate weeks.

hero_healthy_bowl.alt: Top down view of a fresh, colorful vegetable and protein healthy bowl.

empty_plate_diet.alt: Minimalist single blueberry on an empty white plate.

onboarding_fitness.alt: Person holding a healthy drink above dumbbells, fitness lifestyle abstract.

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality tightly. DO NOT introduce blues, purples, or indigo. Stick to the Sage Green (brand) and grayscale/monochrome UI to let the food imagery shine.
For the daily calorie/macro rings and large stat numbers, ensure you implement tabular numerals (fontVariant: ['tabular-nums']) to prevent the layout from jumping when data updates.
Onboarding requires a visually engaging flow: use the `onboarding_fitness` image as a full-bleed background with a heavy bottom scrim so the questions and CTAs remain perfectly legible.

For the Scan flow, focus on a frictionless experience. Implement a 'reticle' overlay during the camera view, and present the AI results in an immediate, editable bottom sheet so users can correct the AI if it's wrong.
Use `expo-glass-effect` (or `expo-blur` on Android) for the bottom tab bar and any sticky header, ensuring you place a semi-transparent tinted backdrop beneath it for readability.

Whenever text is placed over food images (like the Meal Plan cards), ALWAYS use a gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) and position the text at the bottom. Never overlay text without a scrim.
